records.jp: 私、普通でいたくない……
records.en_original: I don't want to be normal...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want to be normal.
records.en: I don't want to be normal...

records.jp: 梨佳！　前に言ってたよね？<CR>走ることが好きなんだって！
records.en_original: Rika! Remember what you said before? That you really love running?
records.en_auxiliary: Rika! Remember what you said before? That you really love running?
records.en: Rika! Remember what you said before? That you really love running?

records.jp: うん……走るの、好きだよ……<CR>でも、結果が出ないんだもん……
records.en_original: Yeah... I do love running... But I'm not producing any results...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I do love running. But I'm not getting any better.
records.en: Yeah... I do love running... But I'm not producing any results...

records.jp: みんなは順調で……私は……
records.en_original: Everyone else is making progress... Except me...
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone else is making progress. Except me.
records.en: Everyone else is making progress... Except me...

records.jp: 羨ましい気持ちもあるだろうけど……<CR>梨佳は良い結果を出したくて陸上部に入ったの？
records.en_original: That could make anyone envious... But did you join the track team just to produce good results?
records.en_auxiliary: That could make anyone envious. But did you join the track team just to produce good results?
records.en: That could make anyone envious... But did you join the track team just to produce good results?

records.jp: ううん……走るのが楽しいから、<CR>ちょっとずつでもタイムが上がるのが嬉しいから……
records.en_original: No... I joined because I loved running, and I was happy when my times gradually got better...
records.en_auxiliary: No, I joined because I loved running, and I was happy when my times gradually got better.
records.en: No... I joined because I loved running, and I was happy when my times gradually got better...

records.jp: そう、梨佳は自分なりの楽しみ方を見つけてるんだよ。<CR>それも、誰かと比べなくてもいい楽しみ方を
records.en_original: That's right. You found something to enjoy in your own way. Something that doesn't compare you with anyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. You found something to enjoy in your own way. Something that doesn't compare you with anyone else.
records.en: That's right. You found something to enjoy in your own way. Something that doesn't compare you with anyone else.

records.jp: 今はタイムのことが気になるかもしれないけど、だからって<CR>勝ち負け以外の楽しさまで見失っちゃダメだよ、梨佳！
records.en_original: You might be worried about your times now, but that's no reason to lose sight of that joy. It's not about winning!
records.en_auxiliary: You might be worried about your times now, but that's no reason to lose sight of that joy. It's not about winning!
records.en: You might be worried about your times now, but that's no reason to lose sight of that joy. It's not about winning!

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako-chan...

records.jp: 梨佳！　日菜子ちゃん！
records.en_original: Rika! Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Rika! Hinako!
records.en: Rika! Hinako-chan!

records.jp: あ、真鈴……
records.en_original: Oh, Marin...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Marin...
records.en: Oh, Marin...

records.jp: よかった、ここにいたのね
records.en_original: So here's where you were. I'm glad I found you.
records.en_auxiliary: So here's where you were. I'm glad I found you.
records.en: So here's where you were. I'm glad I found you.

records.jp: 真鈴……ごめんね
records.en_original: Marin... I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Marin... I'm sorry.
records.en: Marin... I'm sorry.

records.jp: え、急にどうしたの？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you have to apologize for?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What do you have to apologize for?
records.en: Huh? What do you have to apologize for?

records.jp: 私、みんなが羨ましかった……<CR>才能があって、全然普通じゃなくて……
records.en_original: I was envious of everyone else... You all have talent, and you're not normal at all...
records.en_auxiliary: I was envious of everyone else. You all have talent, and you're not normal at all...
records.en: I was envious of everyone else... You all have talent, and you're not normal at all...

records.jp: それで嫉妬してたんだ。顔を合わせたらひどいこと<CR>言っちゃいそうで、怖くなっちゃって
records.en_original: It made me jealous. I felt like I'd say something terrible if I saw you, and I got scared.
records.en_auxiliary: It made me jealous. I felt like I'd say something terrible if I saw you, and I got scared.
records.en: It made me jealous. I felt like I'd say something terrible if I saw you, and I got scared.

records.jp: 何だ、そんな理由だったの？
records.en_original: What, that's all?
records.en_auxiliary: What, that's all?
records.en: What, that's all?

records.jp: 何だって……結構ひどい理由じゃない？<CR>みんなは何も悪くないんだもん
records.en_original: That's all...? Isn't that a terrible reason? None of you did anything wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: That's all? Isn't that terrible? None of you did anything wrong.
records.en: That's all...? Isn't that a terrible reason? None of you did anything wrong.

records.jp: ……じゃあ私も言っちゃうね。<CR>私は梨佳にものすごーく嫉妬してるの！
records.en_original: ...Then let me say something, too. I'm suuuper jealous of you, Rika!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, let me tell you something. I'm suuuper jealous of you, Rika!
records.en: ...Then let me say something, too. I'm suuuper jealous of you, Rika!

records.jp: え、そうなの！？
records.en_original: Wait, you are?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, you are?
records.en: Wait, you are?

records.jp: な、何で……？　私、普通すぎるくらい普通だよ？<CR>嫉妬されるようなこと何もないよ？
records.en_original: Wh-Why...? I'm so normal. Almost TOO normal. There's nothing about me to be jealous over.
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-why? I'm so normal. Almost TOO normal. There's nothing about me to be jealous over.
records.en: Wh-Why...? I'm so normal. Almost TOO normal. There's nothing about me to be jealous over.

records.jp: 結局、自分で認めちゃうんだ……
records.en_original: So you finally admit it...
records.en_auxiliary: So you finally admit it.
records.en: So you finally admit it...

records.jp: だって考えてもみて？　私、特待科に入ったからには<CR>もし陸上が嫌になったとしてもやめられないのよ
records.en_original: Just think about it. Since I'm in the special class, I couldn't quit track and field if I started disliking it.
records.en_auxiliary: Just think about it. Since I'm in the special class, I couldn't quit track and field if I started disliking it.
records.en: Just think about it. Since I'm in the special class, I couldn't quit track and field if I started disliking it.

records.jp: しかも成果を出さないと申し訳ないし、今だって走れなくて<CR>親とか先生とかからのプレッシャーすごいんだから
records.en_original: Not only that, I NEED good results. Since I can't run right now, my parents and teachers are putting the pressure on.
records.en_auxiliary: Not only that, I NEED good results. Since I can't run right now, my parents and teachers are putting the pressure on.
records.en: Not only that, I NEED good results. Since I can't run right now, my parents and teachers are putting the pressure on.

records.jp: （あ……その気持ち、わかる気がする……）
records.en_original: (Ah... I think I understand that feeling...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ah... I think I understand that feeling.)
records.en: (Ah... I think I understand that feeling...)

records.jp: むしろ私の周囲の人はみんな私と似たような立場だから、<CR>私にとって梨佳は全然普通じゃないのよ
records.en_original: Everyone around me's in a similar position, too. To me, Rika, you're far from normal.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone around me's in a similar position, too. To me, Rika, you're far from normal.
records.en: Everyone around me's in a similar position, too. To me, Rika, you're far from normal.

records.jp: だからね、本当に純粋に楽しんでる梨佳が羨ましいの
records.en_original: That's why I'm jealous of you. You get to genuinely enjoy yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I'm jealous of you. You get to genuinely enjoy yourself.
records.en: That's why I'm jealous of you. You get to genuinely enjoy yourself.

records.jp: 真鈴……そうだったんだ……
records.en_original: Marin... I didn't know...
records.en_auxiliary: Marin... I didn't know.
records.en: Marin... I didn't know...

records.jp: ……うん、思ってたこと言えてすっきりした
records.en_original: ...I feel a lot better now that I've said what's on my mind.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel a lot better now that I've said what's on my mind.
records.en: ...I feel a lot better now that I've said what's on my mind.

records.jp: 嫌な気持ちになってたのも全部消えちゃったし、<CR>今ならすごくいい気分で走れそう！
records.en_original: It's like a gloomy fog has lifted. I feel like I could run with a smile on my face again!
records.en_auxiliary: It's like a gloomy fog has lifted. I feel like I can run with a smile again!
records.en: It's like a gloomy fog has lifted. I feel like I could run with a smile on my face again!

records.jp: ふふ、その調子！
records.en_original: Hehe, that's the spirit.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, that's the spirit.
records.en: Hehe, that's the spirit.

records.jp: うん。結果が出ても出なくても、梨佳のこと応援してるよ
records.en_original: Yeah. Even if you don't produce results, I'll be cheering for you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Even if you're not getting the best times on the team, I'll be cheering for you.
records.en: Yeah. Even if you don't produce results, I'll be cheering for you.

records.jp: ありがとう、日菜子ちゃん！<CR>私、最後まで頑張るよ！
records.en_original: Thanks, Hinako! I'll do my best until the very end!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Hinako! I'll do my best all the way to the finish line!
records.en: Thanks, Hinako-chan! I'll do my best until the very end!

records.jp: 解決……したかな？
records.en_original: Is everything solved?
records.en_auxiliary: Is everything solved?
records.en: Is everything solved?

records.jp: 私たちの出る幕はなさそうね。<CR>じゃ、帰りましょうか
records.en_original: Looks like we didn't have much of a part to play here. Let's just head home.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like we didn't have much of a part to play here. Let's just head home.
records.en: Looks like we didn't have much of a part to play here. Let's just head home.

records.jp: もう、ライムはドライすぎだよ……
records.en_original: Ugh, you're so cold about it, Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh, you're so cold about it, Lime.
records.en: Ugh, you're so cold about it, Lime...

records.jp: さっそく練習しなきゃ！<CR>日菜子ちゃん、タイム測るのお願い！
records.en_original: I need to get back to practice! Hinako, could you help me measure my times?
records.en_auxiliary: I need to get back to practice! Hinako, could you help me measure my times?
records.en: I need to get back to practice! Hinako-chan, could you help me measure my times?

records.jp: えっ、今から！？　ま、待って、<CR>行くから引っ張らないで！
records.en_original: Wait, now!? H-Hold on, I'll go with you, stop pulling me!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, now?! H-hold on, I'll go with you! Stop pulling me!
records.en: Wait, now!? H-Hold on, I'll go with you, stop pulling me!

records.jp: あらら……ヒナちゃん、<CR>これはしばらく帰れそうにないね……
records.en_original: Uh oh... Seems like Hinako won't be able to go home for a while...
records.en_auxiliary: Uh oh. Seems like Hinako won't be able to go home for a while.
records.en: Uh-oh... Hina-chan,<CR>looks like you won't be going home for a while...

records.jp: あはは、<CR>ヒナちゃんもりかちんも頑張れー！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Have fun, you two!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha! Have fun, you two!
records.en: Ahaha! Good luck, Hina-chan and Rika-chin!
